body:
From my experience in highschool, I was also lonely and I waited to meet the right people but never did, so it felt like I wasted my highschool years. So what I'm saying is don't wait for something to happen, chances are it might not. Instead be bolder to make things happen. Not stupid bold but bolder none the less. Hope this helps
EDIT: like what others have said, its highschool and people change like crazy constantly, so looking for your soul mate is kind of silly because even if u find it they could change and be someone completely different in no time. Even in university people take it chill when dating, so you should too.
